_comment: RUBBER, NOT PLASTIC, IN THE BOTTOM CELL (owner, 2026-09-04). A pump's diaphragm and seals are
rubber and plastic never was the part doing that job, so this reads correct as well as giving
rubber the consumer it needed - without one it would be a dead end in every install lacking Create.
This EDITS A SHIPPED RECIPE and players holding the blueprint will find it wants a different
ingredient; that belongs in the changelog rather than in a silent substitution.
Plastic is not devalued by the swap: the Cutting Torch, the Plastic Panel and the Rain Collector
Funnel still consume it, and the Panel is an open-ended building sink.
